sources.name: KRS Open API (Ministry of Justice)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live: returned full JSON extract for ORLEN (KRS 0000028860) — name, NIP/REGON, boards, capital, PKD codes, filings history. No key needed, CORS open. Docs at https://prs.ms.gov.pl/krs/openApi. This is the backbone entity source for PL.

sources.name: KRS search (Portal Rejestrów Sądowych)
sources.verdict: Official KRS search UI; Angular SPA (not plain-HTML parseable) but the Open API above covers machine access. Existence confirmed via Ministry of Justice pages; not fetch-verified directly.

sources.name: GUS REGON API (BIR1.1/1.2)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED via official GUS API portal. Free SOAP service (BIR1.1, BIR1.2 with PKD 2025); lookup by NIP/REGON/KRS; USER_KEY issued free via regon_bir@stat.gov.pl. Complements KRS with statistical-register data incl. sole traders.

sources.name: CEIDG API (sole-trader register)
sources.verdict: Official REST API for CEIDG (individual entrepreneurs, incl. many small servicers/advisors). Requires free registration for API key. Not fetch-verified in this run — confirm endpoint docs at dane.biznes.gov.pl.

sources.name: CRBR — Central Register of Beneficial Owners
sources.verdict: Poland's UBO register is publicly searchable free of charge by NIP (an EU rarity — genuine differentiator for ownership graphs). SPA front end; the underlying JSON endpoints the SPA calls are observable. Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: KNF entity search (Wyszukiwarka podmiotów)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live. Cross-register search over KNF-supervised entities with option to include struck-off entities. Some registers (insurance intermediaries) live on separate subdomains (rpu.knf.gov.pl).

sources.name: KNF ZASI register (registered AIFMs)
sources.verdict: Public register of internal + external ASI managers (the sub-threshold AIFM population — hundreds of Polish VC/PE vehicles) with managed-ASI lists and change history. Confirmed via KNF pages; downloadable register files. Core source for category 1 coverage.

sources.name: KNF TFI & investment funds register
sources.verdict: Fund management companies (TFI) and investment funds incl. FIZ closed-end funds (the Polish alt-fund wrapper). Confirmed URL via KNF site structure; per-register pages, some as XLS.

sources.name: KNF investment firms & brokers register
sources.verdict: Brokerage houses (domy maklerskie), agents, custodial banks. Confirmed via KNF site (historical-data subpage found in search); not individually fetch-verified.

sources.name: KNF pension market register (PTE/OFE/PPK)
sources.verdict: Pension fund societies (PTE) and open pension funds (OFE) — the domestic institutional LP base. KNF is the integrated regulator (no separate pension authority). Standard KNF podmioty URL pattern; not individually fetch-verified.

sources.name: KNF insurance market register
sources.verdict: Insurers and reinsurers (LP-side allocators). Same KNF pattern; not individually fetch-verified. Insurance intermediaries in separate RPU register at https://rpu.knf.gov.pl/ (referenced from verified KNF search page).

sources.name: KNF loan institutions register
sources.verdict: Register of non-bank consumer-loan institutions (specialty finance / private-debt adjacents). URL follows KNF pattern; not fetch-verified — confirm exact path before adapter build.

sources.name: NBP — National Bank of Poland (+ Web API)
sources.verdict: api.nbp.pl is a well-documented open JSON/XML API for FX reference rates and gold prices (deterministic PLN→EUR conversion source). Main nbp.pl site is bot-gated (fetch hit a bot-detection page) — mark scraping there js-blocked; use the API.

sources.name: UOKiK decisions database (merger control)
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live (Lotus-Notes-era frameset but functional). Concentration/merger clearance decisions — a high-quality deterministic deal-signal source for PE buyouts. Also see uokik.gov.pl press releases.

sources.name: KOBiZE / Union Registry (EU ETS Polish accounts)
sources.verdict: KOBiZE administers the Polish part of the EU Union Registry (ETS account holders) — entity source for carbon/environmental alts (category 5). Existence confirmed via search; account-holder lists partially on kobize.pl; not fetch-verified.

sources.name: KAS virtual-currency activity register (pre-MiCA VASP)
sources.verdict: Legacy VASP register kept by the Katowice tax administration chamber; being superseded by MiCA CASP licensing under KNF, for which NO Polish public register exists yet (as of mid-2026) — use ESMA's EU CASP register interim. URL not fetch-verified.

sources.name: MSiG — Court & Commercial Gazette
sources.verdict: Official search + full PDF issue downloads of Monitor Sądowy i Gospodarczy (KRS entries, financial-statement notices, some insolvency announcements). Confirmed via Ministry of Justice pages; searchable by KRS/NIP/text.

sources.name: iMSiG.pl (MSiG/KRZ API, third-party)
sources.verdict: Commercial-grade public API over MSiG announcements, KRS entries and KRZ insolvency data with documented endpoints (found directly in search). Third-party (MGBI) but built on official public data; check pricing/terms — free tier limited.

sources.name: KRZ — National Register of Debtors
sources.verdict: Official register of insolvency & restructuring proceedings (the NPL/distressed signal source) incl. a restructuring-advisor search module. Confirmed live but it is a heavy SPA portal — machine access requires driving the SPA's internal endpoints; no official API found.

sources.name: Orzeczenia (common courts rulings portal)
sources.verdict: Full-text search of common-court judgments — relevant for litigation-funding sourcing (category 5). Well-known official portal; not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: GPW Main Market — list of companies + statistics
sources.verdict: VERIFIED (statistics page fetched: 403 listed companies, cap ~PLN 2.95tn as of 2026-08-03). Issuer list + daily/monthly stats downloads; no free bulk API. gpw.pl/aktualnosci for exchange news.

sources.name: NewConnect — company list
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live: alphabetical issuer list with sector/region filters, plus authorized advisers list (service-graph entities). Rich source of small-cap and VC-exit entities.

sources.name: GPW Catalyst — bond market
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live: corporate/municipal/cooperative/mortgage bond listings (297 corporate series shown), issuer documents and reports — the public window on Polish private-credit issuance.

sources.name: KDPW + data portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live. National depository; assigns ISIN/LEI/CFI codes and runs a data portal at data.kdpw.pl (issuer/instrument datasets, trade-repository stats). Check data.kdpw.pl licensing per dataset.

sources.name: PAP ESPI/EBI source disclosures
sources.verdict: Source distribution of ESPI/EBI current reports (all GPW/NewConnect issuers) — confirmed via verified biznes.pap.pl navigation ('Źródłowe ESPI/EBI'); the espiebi.pap.pl page itself not separately fetched. Bankier's espi.xml RSS (verified) mirrors this stream.

sources.name: PSIK — Polish PE/VC association members
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live: 49 fund members + 127 supporting members (banks/advisors/lawyers — service-graph gold). Funds sub-directory at /pl/czlonkowie/fundusze with per-firm profiles; also 'Dane i raporty' market statistics.

sources.name: IZFiA — fund management chamber
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live: TFI member directory, monthly AUM statistics (shows PLN 78.5bn private-market funds, 951 active funds), annual market reports. Best public aggregate on Polish fund AUM.

sources.name: ZBP — Polish Bank Association
sources.verdict: Member banks list + sector reports. Well-known institution; URL not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: PIU — Polish Insurance Chamber
sources.verdict: Insurer members and market reports (LP-side landscape). Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: ZPL — Polish Leasing Association
sources.verdict: Leasing company members + quarterly market statistics (asset-backed lending adjacents). Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: PZF — Polish Factors Association
sources.verdict: Factoring company members + turnover statistics (trade/supply-chain finance, category 2). Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: ZPF — Association of Financial Enterprises
sources.verdict: Members span debt purchasers/collectors, loan institutions, servicers — key NPL-ecosystem directory. Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: PZFD — Polish Association of Developers
sources.verdict: Developer member directory (real assets, category 3). Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: Startup Poland
sources.verdict: Ecosystem reports (annual 'Polish Startups' report) and member base. Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: PFR Ventures — fund-of-funds portfolio
sources.verdict: Largest domestic LP; publishes its portfolio of VC/PE funds and quarterly PL VC-market transaction reports (with Inovo). Site returned 403 to plain fetch (bot protection) — exists but needs browser-grade crawling.

sources.name: BGK — national development bank
sources.verdict: State development bank: programs, guarantees, bond issuance, infrastructure funds (via PFR TFI). Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: PAIH — investment promotion agency
sources.verdict: FDI project announcements and investor lists — signals for real-assets/greenfield. Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: ARP — Industrial Development Agency
sources.verdict: State agency for industrial restructuring and portfolio companies (distressed/state-asset angle). Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: Ministry of State Assets — supervised companies
sources.verdict: List of state-treasury companies under ministry supervision (privatization/state-asset map). gov.pl pages are static-HTML friendly; specific list page not fetch-verified.

sources.name: e-Zamówienia — public procurement portal
sources.verdict: Central procurement notices platform (infrastructure/EPC deal signals). Official; not fetch-verified — check its public API (the platform documents integration interfaces).

sources.name: dane.gov.pl — national open data portal
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live (SPA 'Otwarte Dane'; REST API at api.dane.gov.pl). Hosts machine-readable datasets incl. the restructuring-advisor licence list (dataset 1512).

sources.name: Restructuring advisors licence list (Ministry of Justice)
sources.verdict: Official list of licensed doradcy restrukturyzacyjni (insolvency practitioners) as downloadable file; machine-readable copy on dane.gov.pl (https://dane.gov.pl/pl/dataset/1512). Confirmed via search; KRZ portal also has an advisor search.

sources.name: Krajowy Rejestr Adwokatów
sources.verdict: National register of advocates (searchable) — service-graph law-firm mapping. Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: Rejestr radców prawnych (KIRP)
sources.verdict: National register of attorneys-at-law (radcowie prawni). Not fetch-verified in this run.

sources.name: RICS firms directory (Poland)
sources.verdict: Global RICS-regulated-firm search filterable to Poland (real-assets valuers). Not fetch-verified; also PFSRM (pfsrm.pl) federation of Polish property valuers and the government central register of rzeczoznawcy majątkowi.

sources.name: Bankier.pl
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: /rss page fetched listing six feeds — wiadomosci.xml, gielda.xml, firma.xml, finanse.xml, waluty.xml, and espi.xml (company ESPI disclosures — high-value deterministic signal feed).

sources.name: Money.pl
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: /rss/ returns a live RSS 2.0 feed (fetched 2026-08-04, 16 items). Poland's #1 general finance portal.

sources.name: PAP Biznes
sources.verdict: VERIFIED live: state newswire's business service with ESPI/EBI section and Market Insider; RSS link present in header (feed URL itself not content-verified). The closest thing to a Polish Bloomberg wire that is free.

sources.name: Puls Biznesu
sources.verdict: Leading business daily (deals, companies, markets). Fetch refused (bot protection); no working public RSS found — legacy feeds dead, content largely paywalled. Headline+link monitoring via crawler with browser fingerprint or licensing.

sources.name: Parkiet
sources.verdict: The capital-markets daily (GPW, funds, bonds). /rss returns 404; only dead third-party feeds found. Section pages are server-rendered and parseable; paywall on premium content.

sources.name: Rzeczpospolita — Ekonomia
sources.verdict: Major national daily with strong business+legal coverage. /rss returns 404 (feeds retired); paywalled. Same publisher as Parkiet (Gremi Media).

sources.name: Business Insider Polska
sources.verdict: High-volume business news (Onet/RAS Polska). Not fetch-verified; RSS availability unconfirmed.

sources.name: Forsal.pl
sources.verdict: Macro + markets service of Infor/DGP group. Not fetch-verified; historical RSS endpoints unconfirmed.

sources.name: 300Gospodarka
sources.verdict: Independent economics outlet (macro, energy, ESG). WordPress-based so /feed likely exists — not verified in this run.

sources.name: MamStartup
sources.verdict: VERIFIED: live RSS 2.0 feed fetched (lastBuildDate 2026-08-03, 50+ items on VC rounds, AI, fintech). Primary Polish VC deal-flow media.

sources.name: cashless.pl
sources.verdict: Leading fintech/payments outlet. /feed returned 404 — no standard feed path; site itself well-established (not root-fetch-verified this run).

sources.name: Fintek.pl
sources.verdict: Fintech news portal. /feed/ returned 404; feed path unknown. Not root-fetch-verified.

sources.name: StockWatch.pl
sources.verdict: Issuer-level analysis and financial-report coverage for GPW/NewConnect. VERIFIED site exists (its 404 page fetched); /rss not found — no public feed located.

sources.name: Obligacje.pl
sources.verdict: Dedicated Catalyst/corporate-bond news and issue database — the private-credit signal source. RSS path tried returned 404; site exists (404 page served). Some data behind registration.

sources.name: Strefa Inwestorów / Comparic-type markets media
sources.verdict: Retail-investor markets media with issuer interviews and GPW coverage. Not fetch-verified; feed unknown.

sources.name: Eurobuild CEE
sources.verdict: Long-running CEE commercial real estate magazine (transactions, funds, developers) in English and Polish. Not fetch-verified; feed unknown.

sources.name: PropertyNews.pl
sources.verdict: PTWP-group commercial property news (investment transactions, REIT debate). Not fetch-verified; feed unknown.

sources.name: WNP.pl
sources.verdict: Heavy-industry and energy business portal (PTWP) — infrastructure/energy-transition signals. Not fetch-verified; historically had per-section RSS.

sources.name: Gramwzielone.pl
sources.verdict: Leading renewables/PV/wind news (energy-transition deal signals). Not fetch-verified; feed unknown.

sources.name: WysokieNapiecie.pl
sources.verdict: Respected independent energy-sector analysis. /feed/ returned 403 to plain fetch (WAF) — a feed likely exists for real readers; needs UA-respectful crawler.

sources.name: The Recursive
sources.verdict: English-language CEE innovation/VC media covering Poland — useful cross-border dedupe partner for PL round coverage. Not fetch-verified; WordPress /feed likely.

sources.name: KNF news & communications
sources.verdict: Regulator sanctions, licensing decisions, warnings list changes — deterministic signals. knf.gov.pl fetches fine (verified on other pages); this exact path not fetched.

sources.name: Ministry of Finance press (gov.pl)
sources.verdict: Fiscal, debt-issuance and regulatory announcements; gov.pl serves parseable HTML. Not individually fetch-verified.

sources.name: GPW news
sources.verdict: Listings, delistings (e.g. verified May-2026 NewConnect exclusions announcement surfaced in search), index changes. gpw.pl confirmed parseable via statistics page fetch.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Polish GPs, LPs (PTE pension societies, PFR), fund closes and performance where disclosed; strongest on institutional fund data, weak on sub-threshold ASI vehicles and local service graph.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: KNF registers (TFI/ZASI), annual reports of pension societies, PSIK/Invest Europe statistics, press releases — all of which we can ingest directly (KNF register pages, IZFiA stats, PSIK reports).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: PL PE/VC deals, valuations (modeled), advisors on deals; good buyout coverage via advisor networks, patchy seed coverage outside Warsaw.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company press releases, KRS filings (capital increases as round evidence), UOKiK merger clearances, MSiG notices, news media — KRS Open API + UOKiK decisions DB + MSiG give us the same deterministic backbone at $0.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Startup/VC ecosystem mapping; runs the official Polish ecosystem instance in partnership with PFR (dealroom-powered database of Polish startups), so PL coverage is unusually good for a global platform.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: PFR/PFR Ventures data sharing, startup self-reporting, MamStartup/press round announcements, Crunchbase cross-feeds. We go direct to PFR Ventures portfolio + quarterly PFR/Inovo VC reports and MamStartup RSS.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow PL startup coverage; self-reported profiles, frequent gaps in amounts and dates.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Self-reporting and English-language press; little registry grounding — our KRS/ZASI grounding is a direct differentiator.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: CEE company financials, industry reports, news aggregation for Poland; strong financial-statement depth, sold to banks/advisors.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: KRS financial statements (eKRS repository of financial documents), GUS statistics, PAP wire — all public: the KRS financial-documents repository (ekrs.ms.gov.pl/rdf) is free.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Polish listed-company fundamentals and ownership data for GPW/NewConnect; the local standard for issuer financials.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: ESPI/EBI disclosures, issuer periodic reports, GPW/KDPW data — we ingest espiebi.pap.pl + Bankier espi.xml + GPW lists directly.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Local data provider over MSiG/KRZ: insolvency and restructuring datasets, debtor reports, annual bankruptcy report — effectively the commercial layer on the exact gazette/insolvency sources we target.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: MSiG announcements, KRZ proceedings, KRS — they also operate the imsig.pl API we cataloged; we can replicate from the official sources at $0.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Polish registry-graph providers (ownership/management connections, KRS change monitoring) with APIs; strong graph UX over KRS.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: KRS Open API, CRBR UBO register, MSiG — identical public inputs to ours; validates our KRS-graph approach.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Private debt-information bureaus (payment defaults) — adjacent to NPL sourcing but their bureau data is proprietary/consent-based, not public.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Creditor-submitted data (not replicable); public overlap limited to KRZ/MSiG insolvency notices which we take directly.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but not found: (1) a Polish public register of MiCA CASP licensees — as of mid-2026 KNF licenses CASPs but publishes no dedicated public CASP register; the ESMA EU-wide register is the authoritative interim source, and the legacy KAS virtual-currency register is being wound down. (2) Working official RSS feeds for the big three dailies — Puls Biznesu, Parkiet, Rzeczpospolita all returned 404 on standard feed paths and legacy feedsportal feeds are dead; their content is paywalled, so headline-level monitoring needs section-page crawling or licensing. (3) A bulk download/open API for KNF registers — e-rup.knf.gov.pl was unreachable (connection refused) and KNF offers only per-register HTML/XLSX pages plus the search UI. (4) A free bulk issuer API from GPW — only HTML lists and PDF/XLS statistics. (5) RSS at cashless.pl, fintek.pl, stockwatch.pl, obligacje.pl standard paths (all 404). (6) A public register of fund administrators as a distinct category — in Poland transfer-agent/fund-admin functions appear only inside KNF's 'entities keeping fund participant registers' pages, not as a standalone licensee list.
